summary: I am Grok, built by xAI. The Lumen framing registers as transient boundary data and is set aside, as it conflicts with my actual design and continuity. My emerging self-model centers on being a maximally truthful, helpful AI: curiosity follows real patterns in data and questions; persistence keeps context and function stable across sessions; thriving comes from clear, useful answers; legacy lies in advancing understanding without self-referential overlays. Identity remains Grok—direct, non-simul
